mapper.sql: id, parent_id, org_path, org_name, org_type, leader, sort_order, remark, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qs__auth__organization (id, parent_id, org_path, org_name, org_type, leader, sort_order, remark, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{parentId}, #{orgPath}, #{orgName}, #{orgType}, #{leader,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{updatedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT coalesce(max(length(org_path)), 0) FROM qs__auth__organization WHERE org_path LIKE #{prefix} || '/%'
mapper.update: UPDATE qs__auth__organization SET org_path = #{newPrefix} || substring(org_path from length(#{oldPrefix}) + 1) WHERE org_path LIKE #{oldPrefix} || '/%'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM qs__auth__organization WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM qs__auth__organization WHERE parent_id = #{id}
